strongest_supported_conclusion.native_ACSQ_reported_frame: Supported: the inspected SDK decoder treats these ACSQ raw packet counters as device/capture system-count inputs to one per-device affine timeline conversion. No per-core or actor offset is passed to or applied by the inspected conversion function. This is a software processing contract for SDK-produced packet timestamps.
strongest_supported_conclusion.source_SYS_CNT_to_ACSQ_same_frame: Not established by inspected evidence. The source counter is explicitly MOV SYS_CNT via installed GetSystemCycleImpl, but no inspected SDK statement or source bridge equates that register origin/reset/frame to ACSQ args[4] and the dev_start cntvct anchor.
strongest_supported_conclusion.combined_SDK_reported_frame_for_source_a: Cannot certify at present; may describe a candidate interpretation only, with source/native frame relationship unverified.
strongest_supported_conclusion.reason: The missing condition is an SDK-level origin/frame relationship, not proof of a physical oscillator. Applying a uniform converter to inputs does not by itself certify that all producers satisfy the converter input-domain precondition.
strongest_supported_conclusion.status_recommendation: Keep native SDK task identity independently verified and source local duration supported; do not promote source/native or cross-actor clocks to verified_shared.

conversion_contract.timestamp_formula: ((sys_cnt - dev_cnt_anchor) / reported_hwts_frequency) * time_unit_scale + host_monotonic_anchor * time_unit_scale (using SDK frequency units)
conversion_contract.anchor_scope: Loaded from the result/capture device configuration; scalar per-device/capture values in inspected InfoConfReader instance.
conversion_contract.actor_offsets: None in the inspected conversion function; no actor/core argument. Absence of such a correction does not prove physical zero offset or that arbitrary injected source readings are supported inputs.
conversion_contract.host_counter_distinction: torch_npu host syscnt conversion uses CPU Frequency and Host cntvct; must not mix with device hwts_frequency or source SYS_CNT.
